'''Trevayne''' was an individual who was a member of the [[Calimondra family|family]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vilia Calimondra]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Calimondra's grandson [[Odion]] seized control of the [[Helm of Ieldis]], a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that he planned to use to eliminate his rival [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lords]]. In an attempt to stop him, Calimondra ordered Trevayne and the rest of her family to [[Battle of Vanahame|send]] forces to [[Vanahame]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] where Odion was using the negative emotions of children to power his relic.
